entities.summary: Dimitar Zlatanov is a retired Bulgarian volleyball player who is a three-time Olympian. Zlatanov won a silver medal at the 1980 Olympics, and also previously competed at the 1968 and 1972 Olympics. He won eight national championships with the club team CSKA of Sofia. He is widely regarded as one of the best players of all time.
